name: Question 2
problem:
Consider the vector $x$ and the subspace $S=\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ where

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,\,x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ -4\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the distance between $x$ and the subspace $S$ given that the set ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ is orthogonal.
worked_solution:
Since the set ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ is orthogonal, the orthogonal projection of $x$ onto the subspace $S$ is given by

$$
{\text{proj}}_{S}\,x={\text{proj}}_{{a}_{1}}x+{\text{proj}}_{{a}_{2}}x.
$$

So, we first find the orthogonal projections of $x$ onto $\text{Span}{{a}_{1}}$ and $\text{Span}{{a}_{2}}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{{a}_{1}}x & =\frac{x\cdot {a}_{1}}{{a}_{1}\cdot {a}_{1}}{a}_{1}=\frac{2\cdot 1+2\cdot 1+(-4)\cdot 4}{{1}^{2}+{1}^{2}+{4}^{2}}{a}_{1}=(-\frac{2}{3})[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\ {\text{proj}}_{{a}_{2}}x & =\frac{x\cdot {a}_{2}}{{a}_{2}\cdot {a}_{2}}{a}_{2}=\frac{2\cdot 2+2\cdot 2+(-4)\cdot (-1)}{{2}^{2}+{2}^{2}+(-1)^{2}}{a}_{2}=\frac{4}{3}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{S}\,x & ={\text{proj}}_{{a}_{1}}x+{\text{proj}}_{{a}_{2}}x \\  & =(-\frac{2}{3})[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 4\end{aligned}]+\frac{4}{3}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{2}{3}([\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1 \\ -4\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}]) \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2 \\ -4\end{aligned}]=x.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $x$ coincides with the projection, the distance between $x$ and the subspace $S$ is zero $0.$

EXPLANATION

Since the set {a1,a2} is orthogonal, the orthogonal projection of x onto the subspace S is given by

projSx=proja1x+proja2x.

So, we first find the orthogonal projections of x onto Span{a1} and Span{a2}:

proja1x=x⋅a1a1⋅a1a1=2⋅1+2⋅1+(−4)⋅412+12+42a1=(−23)[114]proja2x=x⋅a2a2⋅a2a2=2⋅2+2⋅2+(−4)⋅(−1)22+22+(−1)2a2=43[22−1]

Therefore, we have that projSx=proja1x+proja2x=(−23)[114]+43[22−1]=23([−1−1−4]+[44−2])=[22−4]=x.

Since x coincides with the projection, the distance between x and the subspace S is zero 0.
